No. 450 भारत सरकार GOVERNMENT OF INDIA एस.जी.-डी.एल.-अ.-17022026-270201 SG-DL-E-17022026-270201 -- 1 of 2 -- 2 DELHI GAZETTE : EXTRAORDINARY PART IV] 2. संिोधन: दिल्ली जनिःिुल्क एिं अजनिायय बाल जिक्षा अजधकार जनयम, 2011 के जनयम 3 में उपजनयम (2) के स्ट् थान पर जनम्नजलजित प्र जतस्ट्थाजपत दकया िाएगा :- "(2). जिद्यालय प्र बंधन सजमजत की कुल क्ष मता का 75 प्र जतित जिद्यालय में नामांदकत बच्चों के माता-जपता या अजभभाि कहोंगे। ऐसे जिद्यालयों में िहााँ दिव्ांग िन अजधकार अजधजनयम, 2016 के अंतगयत पठरभाजर्त जिजिष्ट दिव्ांगता िाले एक या एक से अजधक बच्चे नामांदकत हैं, ऐसे बच्चे के कम से कम एक माता-जपता या अजभभािक को सिस्ट्य के रू प में िाजमल दकया िाएगा, जिनका चयन ऐसे माता-जपता या अजभभाि कों में से दकया िाएगा।" राष्ट्रीय रािधानी क्षेत्र , दिल्ली के उपराज्यपाल के आिेि से, उनके नाम पर, प ां डुरांग के. पोल, आई.ए.एस., सजचि (जिक्षा ) DIRECTORATE OF EDUCATION: RIGHT TO EDUCATION BRANCH NOTIFICATION Delhi, the 4th December, 2026 F. No. DE.23(123)/RTE/SMC/CwSN/2025/204-218.—In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 38 read with sub-section (1) of Section 21 of the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009 (Act No. 35 of 2009), the Lieutenant Governor of the National Capital Territory of Delhi hereby makes the following rules to amend the Delhi Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Rules, 2011, published vide notification no. DE.23(462)/Sch./Br./10/17-33, dated 23.11.2011, in the Delhi Gazette, namely: 1. Short Title and Commencement:- (1) These rules shall be called the Delhi Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (Amendment) Rules, 2025. (2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Delhi Gazette. 2. Amendment: In the Delhi Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Rules, 2011, in Rule 3, in place of sub-rule (2), the following shall be substituted: "(2). Seventy-five percent of the total strength of the School Management Committee shall comprise parents or guardians of children enrolled in the school. In schools where one or more Children with specific disabilities, as defined under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, are enrolled, at least one parent or guardian of such a child shall be included as a member, selected from among such parents or guardians." By Order and in the Name of Lt. Governor of National Capital Territory of Delhi, PANDURANG K. POLE, I.A.S., Secy.
